models.summary: Sample variance uses all squared deviations from the estimated sample mean and divides by sample size minus one.

relationship.translation_notes: n=len(squares); the literal1 removes the estimated-mean degree of freedom, not an empirical constant. U^2 divided by a dimensionless count yieldsU^2. All terms are squared values even if their original deviations were negative.
